transcript:
Advisor: Hi Maria, it's Sarah. How have the last couple of months been?
Maria: Better, honestly. I joined an online grief support group and it's helped a lot. I've met some kind people.
Advisor: I'm really glad to hear that.
Maria: There's one man, James, who lost his wife too. He works as an engineer on an offshore oil platform, so we mostly message. He's been so understanding.
Advisor: It's good to have people who understand.
Maria: He's very into investing. He keeps telling me about crypto and how much he's made. I never paid attention to that stuff before, but he makes it sound pretty smart.
Advisor: It's worth being careful there. It's a lot more volatile than what you own.
Maria: Oh, I know. I'm just curious. I'm not doing anything. The insurance money came in, by the way.
Advisor: Yes, I see the $250,000 in the money market. Everything else is on track with your moderate-growth plan.
Maria: Good. Diego's coming home for Easter, so that'll be nice.
Advisor: Wonderful. Let's check in again in May.
Maria: Sounds good. Thanks, Sarah.
